text: DRUG INTERACTIONS THE CNS EFFECTS OF BUTALBITAL MAY BE ENHANCED BY MONOAMINE OXIDASE (MAO) INHIBITORS. BUTALBITAL, ACETAMINOPHEN, AND CAFFEINE MAY ENHANCE THE EFFECTS OF: OTHER NARCOTIC ANALGESICS, ALCOHOL, GENERAL ANESTHETICS, TRANQUILIZERS SUCH AS CHLORDIAZEPOXIDE, SEDATIVE-HYPNOTICS, OR OTHER CNS DEPRESSANTS, CAUSING INCREASED CNS DEPRESSION. CONTRAINDICATIONS THIS PRODUCT IS CONTRAINDICATED UNDER THE FOLLOWING CONDITIONS: HYPERSENSITIVITY OR INTOLERANCE TO ANY COMPONENT OF THIS PRODUCT PATIENTS WITH PORPHYRIA.
